description:
## Why This Exists

commands/list.rs::newnews() has a comment saying 'conservative: return all groups' but actually returns an EMPTY list. The function signature takes _since_timestamp (underscore-prefixed, unused). This is confusing.

lifecycle.rs properly intercepts NEWNEWS at line 600 via handle_newnews_live() which calls overview_store.message_ids_since(). The stub in commands/list.rs is never called from the live path.

## What To Do

1. Fix the misleading doc comment in newnews() to say 'dead code stub; live path is handle_newnews_live in lifecycle.rs'
2. OR remove the stub entirely if it only exists for tests (tests call it directly).

Note: fault_store_errors.rs tests call newnews() directly so the stub cannot be deleted without updating tests.
title: NEWNEWS stub in commands/list.rs is dead code with misleading comment
